ranking.name: Bluegreen Vacations Club La Pension, Ascend Resort Collection

text.text_excerpt: Great place to stay when in NOLA. They have studio, one and two bedroom units. The concierge can help with any questions you may have and the staff is very friendly and attentive. Be sure and use the valet ($30/night) because parking can be tricky in the area. Skip the sales pitch and owner updates if you can- unless you have 2-3 hours to kill ;). It is walking distance to just about anything you want to see or do in the French Quarter. This is the first time we have been given wristbands which will give you discounts at certain businesses.

Great hotel to stay in; especially for the cost! It's located in a great area near food and shops in the French Quarter. We especially loved the art pieces in the room. The staff was all very friendly, and the concierge was always willing to give us food or transportation suggestions and help! The sun deck outside was a great location to take pictures or just sit and talk. The one thing you have to know going in is that there's no maid service; because it's more of a rental place than a hotel. We would definitely stay here again and loved the unique and fun vibe!

As usual, everything about our stay at Club La Pensionne was nothing less than WONDERFUL EXCEPT FOR THE HOUSEKEEPING DEPARTMENT. We had been assured for 3 days that our room would be serviced! The accommodations are spotless and contemporary which mirror the art and music scene that makes New Orleans so attractive to travelers. The attitude of the staff is amazing. From the moment you enter the lobby you feel at home and welcome. Special thanks to Jessica, Charmaine and Will who go out of their way with any and all requests.
